categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies .clang-tidy to enable thirteen additional static analysis checks, which falls under linter configuration in test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Enabling additional bugprone clang-tidy checks improves static analysis coverage across the codebase and resolves a minor test bug. As the author notes, 'Apart from a test-only bug, they didn't find anything severe, but I think it still makes sense to enable them, so that it is easier to read the resulting code.' Fixing the test-only string literal truncation and enforcing checks provides clear hygiene value without addressing urgent framework regressions.
